interface.displayName: Roster — Google Ads and Meta Ads reporting and campaign setup
interface.longDescription: Google Ads and Meta Ads client reports, and new Meta Ads campaigns. Design a report once, in plain language; Roster refreshes it from live data whenever you're ready, and you send your client a link to the figures you've checked. Campaigns are drafted with you and created paused, only after your yes. Meta Ads campaigns are in early access, turned on agency by agency. Google Ads campaigns open soon; until then Roster only reads your Google Ads accounts.
